name: Block Dangerous Commands
description: Prevents rm -rf, git push --force, and other destructive operations from being executed
content:
#!/bin/bash
DANGEROUS_PATTERNS=('rm -rf /' 'git push --force' 'git reset --hard' 'DROP TABLE' 'DROP DATABASE')
for pattern in "${DANGEROUS_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
  if echo "$1" | grep -q "$pattern"; then
    echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected: $pattern"
    exit 2
  fi
done
exit 0
